countedBy: recount from the rectified Gemeente Amsterdam panorama aimed at the street front (b_20241211_0838_Track26_Sphere_00086, 2024-12-11, wall 343 deg, scripts/pand-reference/all-walls.ts) by the cleanup-batch-3 lane, 2026-10-13; replaces the blind haiku count of 2026-10-11, which treated the turret, church gable, porch and tower as one 3-column facade (rows 4,4,1) and matched neither the photo nor the model
note: The street front is four wall planes at different depths, so each gets its own count: the church gable above the porch, the porch with the ground-floor lights beside it, the round stair turret, and the tower. alongM is metres from the whole front's viewer-left silhouette edge. The two ground-floor twin lights flank the porch symmetrically (the right one was missing from the model until this recount). The tower shows three openings on its street face: a louvred twin low down, a glazed twin in a stone surround, and the louvred twin under the corbels (the model had a single narrow light in place of the first two). The turret's oriel row is null: the photo shows two lights square-on and a third foreshortened at the edge, which is not countable.
